record.question: According to the CCS (Leave) Rules, 1972, which of the following is true regarding the powers of the leave sanctioning authority?
options: The authority may change the type of leave without the employee's consent
The authority must always accept the leave applied for
The authority may refuse or revoke leave but cannot alter the kind of leave unless requested in writing by the Government servant
The authority can alter any kind of leave applied for in the public interest
